events.title: 🃏 Demo Patch v0.23.2 - QOL & Next Fest
events.summary: 🃏 Demo Patch v0.23.2 - QOL & Next FestHey there, I've got a new update! In preparation for Next Fest I have been hard at working fixing small issues and trying to improve the game in the smaller ways. This will probably be one of the last updates to the demo before the full game launch. It's been a great time building this game, I can't wait for everyone to play the full version! PS. Mac will get support very soon, I am just working on a few issues with it

events.title: Demo Patch v0.23.1 - QOL & Balancing
events.summary: 🃏 Demo Patch v0.23.1 - QOL & BalancingBug FixesFixed an issue where the 'Discount II' and 'Discount III' vouchers were displayed with incorrect names.Quality of Life ImprovementsDescription Clarity: Clarified descriptions for all scaling power chips and various shop items for better readability.Tutorial Improvements: Updated tutorial text explanations to make mechanics easier to grasp. Added a safety power during the tutorial section to prevent players from busting while learning.Visual Tweaks:

events.title: Demo Release - OUT NOW!
events.summary: 🃏Odds At Oddity Demo Out NOW!You can now download and play the demo of Odds At Oddity!The demo release has:5 casinos (2 of them being a boss casino) to play through. Over 80 powers to play with and find cool combinations. The entire gameplay loopWe are now one step closer to the full game release, I'd love for you to try the game out and leave feedback on the game. Community Discord ServerIf you have any suggestions, bugs to report or general feedback you can let me know in the Official Discord
